description: Header file for a C++ formatting library providing std::ostream support, including classes and functions for formatting and printing to output streams.

classes.name: file_access
classes.description: Template class for accessing FILE* from a buffer object.

classes.name: basic_ostream_formatter
classes.description: Formatter class for objects supporting ostream operator<<.

methods.name: write_buffer
methods.description: Writes buffer content to an output stream.

methods.name: streamed
methods.description: Creates a streamed_view for formatting via ostream operator<<.

methods.name: vprint
methods.description: Prints formatted data to an output stream.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints formatted data to an output stream.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Prints formatted data followed by a newline to an output stream.
